title: Nonnegativity of an expected absolute power
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function and let $p\in\bbr$ be any real exponent. Then, under the uniform measure on the hypercube, the expected value of $\abs{f}^p$ is nonnegative:
\[
  \E\!\left[\,\abs{f}^{\,p}\,\right]\;=\;2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}\abs{f(x)}^{\,p}\;\ge\;0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f a Boolean function on the n-dimensional hypercube
replaced: For any real exponent $p$ and Boolean function $f$, $\E[\,\abs{f}^p\,] \ge 0$.
